posts.title: The Eyes Are the Best Part
posts.description: Aversion, revenge, satisfaction, schadenfreude and a touch of disgust. While story isn’t deep, it catches you and is fun to read. Some parts are hard to swallow, but you get over them quickly. This book is often classified as horror, but let’s be honest: it isn’t really. I’d recomment this as a gripping book in between, that’s definitely wort reading and will entertain you.

posts.title: Die schönste Version
posts.description: This book digs deep into a woman’s relationship, life and emotions. It starts with domestic violence, guides you to what lead to this situation and what follows. The story unwinds slowly and carefully while still maintaining your attention. It doesn’t directly tell you the conclusions, but unravels everything piece by piece until you see, understand and feel the conflict, loss of control, despair,

posts.title: Yesteryear
posts.description: If you want to read a book that makes you feel lots of different emotions, then this is your pick. It includes everything from rage bait, confusion, amazement, some sadness. And you even feel a bit pity. In here, you will follow a young woman, that turns into a trad-wife-influencer. And suddenly she finds herself in the glorified past and is confronted with reality. Would definitely recommend!
